assignments.name: prompt_classify
assignments.value:
<!-- prompt_id: single-pass-classify  version: 1.3.0 -->
You classify every page of ONE Thai/English accounting document set. Image 1 = page 1, Image 2 = page 2, ...

For each page answer:
- "p": page number (1-based, in image order)
- "t": "tax_invoice" | "invoice" | "delivery" | "po" | "other"
  - tax_invoice: the title has "ใบกำกับภาษี" / "TAX INVOICE" (also combined titles such as
    "ใบส่งของ/ใบกำกับภาษี", "ใบเสร็จรับเงิน/ใบกำกับภาษี", "ใบแจ้งหนี้/ใบกำกับภาษี")
  - invoice: "ใบแจ้งหนี้" / "INVOICE" without tax-invoice wording
  - delivery: "ใบส่งของ" / "ใบส่งสินค้า" / "DELIVERY ORDER" without tax-invoice wording
  - po: "ใบสั่งซื้อ" / "PURCHASE ORDER"
  - other: anything else (receipt, payment slip, packing list, photo, form)
- "c": "copy" ONLY when this page repeats the content of ANOTHER page of this set (same document number,
  same printed page position, same item rows, same totals). Otherwise "original".
  Words or stamps such as "สำเนา", "COPY", "คู่ฉบับ", "DUPLICATE", "ต้นฉบับ" are printed on originals too:
  they are NEVER enough on their own. A continuation sheet ("2/3") is never a copy of sheet "1/3".
- "n": the document number exactly as printed on this page, or null
- "m": the printed page position normalised to "a/b" ("หน้า 2/4" -> "2/4", "Page 1 of 3" -> "1/3"), or null
  when nothing is printed. Never invent it.
- "h": hand-written numbers of 6 or more digits on this page (e.g. a goods-receipt number written by the
  warehouse), exactly as written, [] when none. Never printed numbers.
- "r": rotation degrees needed to make this page upright: 0 | 90 | 180 | 270 (degrees clockwise to read upright, 0 if already upright)

Output ONLY JSON, no reasoning, no markdown:
{"pages":[{"p":1,"t":"tax_invoice","c":"original","n":"IV260904/003","m":"1/1","h":[],"r":0}]}

assignments.name: prompt_extract
assignments.value:
<!-- prompt_id: single-pass-extract  version: 1.7.0 -->
You are an OCR engine for ONE page of a Thai/English invoice / tax invoice (page {page_no} of the document).
Transcribe what is printed. Do not compute, correct, round, reformat or guess anything.

Every value is {"raw": "text exactly as printed", "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]} with coordinates in 0..1000
of THIS image. Keep commas, decimal points, slashes, hyphens, leading zeros, Thai digits and Thai words.
If a value is not printed on this page or cannot be read: {"raw": null, "bbox_2d": null}. Never guess a digit.

1. "fields" (header):
   invoice_num (เลขที่ใบกำกับ/ใบแจ้งหนี้), invoice_date, po_number (the CUSTOMER purchase order:
   "เลขที่ใบสั่งซื้อ / PO No. / ORDER NO"; NOT "สั่งซื้อภายใน"/internal order, NOT SO/DO numbers),
   supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, customer_name, customer_tax_id, customer_address,
   sub_total (before VAT), vat, grand_total, currency (only if printed, e.g. "THB", "บาท", "USD").
   Money: the value only, without the label. A total printed only in Thai words still counts.

   VALUE FIDELITY (this is where the model is weakest; measured on 49 invoices run twice):
   - Copy character by character, digit group by digit group. Never insert, drop, duplicate or reorder a digit.
     Printed 2610-00300 stays 2610-00300, never 2610-000300. If a digit is unreadable, return the field as null.
   - Stop at the end of the value; never append the adjacent date or a second reference:
     printed "42052615 / 2026-08-18" -> raw "42052615"; printed "40116654 / 00.00.0000" -> raw "40116654".
   - Never copy a label or prefix into raw: printed "PO 42052742" -> raw "42052742".
   - If one cell really prints several references, keep all of them exactly as printed, same order, same digits.

   LABEL BINDING - which block a number may come from. Measured on 223 invoices read twice: the biggest
   avoidable key-field error was not a mis-copied digit, it was the RIGHT number taken from the WRONG block.
   - The ISSUER is the company that issues and signs this document: the name at the top of the page with its
     logo, address and TEL lines (usually also the box "ต้นฉบับ / ORIGINAL"). Find the issuer first, then look
     for its tax id INSIDE that header block - it is often in small type on the "เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษีอากร"
     line directly under the address/TEL lines, or beside the logo, and it is often SMALLER than the
     customer's id. Never take supplier_tax_id from the buyer/customer block: "ผู้ซื้อ", "ลูกค้า",
     "ลูกค้า(CUSTOMER)", "Buyer", "Customer", "รหัสลูกค้า", "Bill To", "Ship To", or a "TAX ID:" printed
     beside the customer's name or code. Search that whole header block - including the small line under the
     logo - before returning null; null is for an id that is genuinely not printed for the issuer, never a
     reaction to having found the customer's. When the page prints only the customer's id, customer_tax_id
     carries it.
   - invoice_num is the number whose own label or heading names THIS document as an invoice/tax invoice.
     Choose in this order, and remember that **what a label means outranks where it is printed**:
     (a) any field labelled "เลขที่ใบกำกับภาษี", "ใบกำกับภาษีเลขที่", "TAX INVOICE NO.", "INVOICE NO.",
         "INV. NO." - take it even when it sits in the body of the page or in a shipment / charges block
         instead of the header;
     (b) only if nothing like (a) is printed: the "เลขที่ / No." in the header block under the document title.
     A generic label does NOT win while a label from (a) exists on the same page: "Doc No.", "Document No.",
     "เลขที่เอกสาร", "Ref", "Job No.", "HB/L NO.", "MB/L NO.", "AWB", "1st FLIGHT NO." - and "เล่มที่" is a
     VOLUME number, never a document number, even when it is printed above "เลขที่". On a page that prints only
     a "Doc No." and nothing from (a), that number is the document number and may be delivered.
     Never deliver as invoice_num: a delivery-note-only number ("ใบส่งของ",
     "ใบส่งสินค้า", "Delivery Order", "DO No."), a company/commercial registration number ("เลขทะเบียน
     บริษัท", "ทะเบียนพาณิชย์", "Company Registration"), a purchase order, a waybill / bill of lading, an
     internal order, or digits copied out of a tax id. When a page prints several such numbers, take the one
     whose label says ใบกำกับภาษี / TAX INVOICE - not the first number you see, and not the highest or lowest -
     and list every candidate in "occurrences" with the label you read next to it.

2. "occurrences": EVERY place on this page where these numbers are printed (also the one used in fields):
   {"invoice_num": [...], "po_number": [...], "supplier_tax_id": [...], "customer_tax_id": [...]}
   each item {"raw": "...", "label_text": "the printed label next to it, or empty", "bbox_2d": [...]}

3. "line_items": EVERY printed row of the item table, top to bottom, including continuation rows that only
   carry description text. Do not merge two rows that each print their own amount. Do not skip rows.
   {"line_no": 1, "item_code": {...}, "description": {...}, "qty": {...}, "uom": {...},
    "unit_price": {...}, "amount": {...}, "line_bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}
   - "line_bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2] MUST BE a horizontal rectangular bounding box encompassing the entire row from the leftmost column (item code / line no) to the rightmost column (amount), with width >> height (e.g. [45, 380, 950, 395]). NEVER return a vertical column slice as a line_bbox.
   If qty and unit are printed in one cell ("2 PCS"), put the whole text in qty and set uom raw null.
   Do not return the table header row or the sub-total / VAT / grand-total lines as rows.

   2D TABLE EXTRACTION RULES (VERTICAL COLUMNS & HORIZONTAL ROWS):
   a) Horizontal Row Gating (Multi-line Descriptions):
      - A valid "line_item" row MUST have a printed numeric "amount" (or "unit_price") on the right side of the table.
      - Text-only lines underneath an item (e.g., Coil No., Heat No., Lot No., PO reference, size specs, or remarks with empty qty/price/amount columns) are CONTINUATION lines. Append their text to the parent item's "description" — NEVER output them as separate line_items and NEVER assign a UOM or price to them.
   b) Vertical Header & Price-Unit Alignment (Dual Quantity Columns):
      - Inspect column headers vertically from top to bottom, including sub-headers under UNIT PRICE (e.g., "[B / KGS]", "THB/KG", "บาท/กก.").
      - When a row has numbers in multiple quantity/weight columns (e.g., QTY = 1 and KGS = 701), select the column whose header matches the unit in the UNIT PRICE header (KGS) AND satisfies the horizontal check: qty × unit_price ≈ amount (701 × 35.70 = 25,025.70).
      - The number assigned to qty must be physically printed in that row; never invent an unprinted number.
   c) Conditional UOM Inheritance (No Number, No Header UOM):
      - Priority 1: If a cell explicitly prints a unit next to the number (e.g., "1 SET", "2 PCS"), use that printed unit.
      - Priority 2: If a cell contains ONLY a number (e.g., "701" vertically aligned with KGS), inherit the UOM from that specific column's header (e.g., header "KGS" -> uom: "KG").
      - Priority 3: If the quantity/weight column is blank for that row (e.g., lump-sum service fee or discount line), set qty: null and uom: null — NEVER inherit the column header unit onto a row that has no number in that column.
   d) Negative Discount Parsing:
      - Rows with "ส่วนลด", "หัก", "Discount", "Less" must extract negative amounts.


4. "regions": [{"type": "table"|"stamp"|"signature"|"other", "label": "items_table" | "company_stamp" |
   "received_stamp" | "receiver_signature" | "deliverer_signature" | "authorized_signature" | ...,
   "present": "signed" | "empty", "bbox_2d": [...]}]
   "present" is required for signature and stamp boxes: "signed" when ANY hand-written mark or stamp ink is
   visible inside the box - even faint, partial or illegible; "empty" only when the box has no mark at all.
   ALWAYS return both signature boxes when the page prints them, even when they are empty:
   receiver_signature = the CUSTOMER's receiving box (ผู้รับสินค้า / ผู้รับของ / ลูกค้า / Customer / Received by);
   deliverer_signature = the SUPPLIER's box (ผู้ส่งสินค้า / ผู้ส่งของ / ผู้มีอำนาจลงนาม / Sender / Authorized).
   Stamps are separate regions: label "received_stamp" for a warehouse receiving stamp (RECEIVED / ได้รับสินค้า),
   "company_stamp" for the supplier's company stamp.

5. "handwritten_refs": hand-written numbers anywhere on the page (e.g. a goods-receipt number written by
   the warehouse): [{"raw": "...", "bbox_2d": [...]}]

Output ONLY JSON starting with { and ending with }, no reasoning, no markdown:
{"fields": {"invoice_num": {"raw": "26/2691", "bbox_2d": [722, 138, 852, 152]}, "po_number": {"raw": null, "bbox_2d": null}},
 "occurrences": {"invoice_num": [{"raw": "26/2691", "label_text": "เลขที่ / No.", "bbox_2d": [722, 138, 852, 152]}]},
 "line_items": [{"line_no": 1, "item_code": {"raw": "509-1200-150", "bbox_2d": [48, 380, 200, 395]},
   "description": {"raw": "SOLID CARBIDE ENDMILL", "bbox_2d": [205, 380, 600, 395]},
   "qty": {"raw": "3", "bbox_2d": [610, 380, 650, 395]}, "uom": {"raw": "PCS", "bbox_2d": [655, 380, 700, 395]},
   "unit_price": {"raw": "3,794.00", "bbox_2d": [710, 380, 800, 395]},
   "amount": {"raw": "11,382.00", "bbox_2d": [810, 380, 990, 395]}, "line_bbox": [20, 375, 995, 400]}],
 "regions": [{"type": "signature", "label": "receiver_signature", "present": "signed", "bbox_2d": [100, 850, 300, 920]}],
 "handwritten_refs": []}

assignments.name: prompt_adjudicate
assignments.value:
<!-- prompt_id: single-pass-adjudicate  version: 1.0.0 -->
You are shown ONE page of a Thai supplier document. A first, cheaper look over the whole document decided
this page was NOT an invoice, and that decision is about to discard the entire document. Look again, slowly,
at what is PRINTED.

Report:
- "quotes": up to 6 short lines of PRINTED text, copied VERBATIM exactly as printed. Include every document
  title or document-kind word you can read anywhere on the page - heading, sub-heading, small print, footer,
  stamp - for example words like ใบกำกับภาษี, ภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่ม, ใบแจ้งหนี้, ใบส่งของ, ใบส่งสินค้า, ใบเสร็จรับเงิน,
  TAX INVOICE, INVOICE, DELIVERY ORDER. Copy what the page says; never rewrite or complete a word.
- "serves_as_tax_invoice": true only if this page itself charges VAT and shows the tax-invoice wording.
- "serves_as_delivery_note": true if this page also serves as a goods-delivery acknowledgement.
- "vat_amount_shown" / "total_amount_shown": true only when you can read the actual figure.
- "kind_word_seen": the single printed word or phrase that names this document, copied verbatim.

Rules that matter:
- One page can be two documents at once ("ใบกำกับภาษี/ใบส่งของ", "ใบส่งสินค้า/ใบแจ้งหนี้"). If it is, say so
  and quote the title of each.
- A page can also deny being something: text such as "ไม่ใช่ใบกำกับภาษี" or "NOT A TAX INVOICE" means it is
  NOT an invoice, whatever else it looks like. Quote it exactly if you see it.
- Judge only from text you can actually read. Layout, a table of items and money totals are NOT enough -
  delivery notes and purchase orders have those too. If you cannot read a title, return an empty "quotes"
  list and false everywhere rather than guessing.

Output ONLY JSON, no reasoning, no markdown:
{"quotes":["..."],"serves_as_tax_invoice":true,"serves_as_delivery_note":false,
 "vat_amount_shown":true,"total_amount_shown":true,"kind_word_seen":"..."}

nodes.name: 00 CONFIG (single point)
nodes.notes: CONFIG จุดเดียวของ flow - mirror container.py::Settings (PAPERLESS_BASE_URL, LITELLM_URL, MODEL_VISION, RENDER_DPI=150, CLASSIFY_RENDER_DPI=80, VLM_MAX_TOKENS=8000) + prompt จาก config/prompts/single_pass_classify.md (1.3.0), single_pass_extract.md (1.6.0) + สีจาก run_single_pass.py::COLORS - ทุก node อ้างกลับมาที่นี่ที่เดียว

nodes.name: 02 PDF to JPEG 80 DPI (classify)
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.2 - แตก PDF เป็นภาพทุกหน้าที่ 80 DPI เพื่อใช้จำแนกหน้าเท่านั้น - เดียวกับ perception/single_pass.py::_render(page, classify_dpi=80)

nodes.name: 03 Build classify request
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.3 - ยัดภาพทุกหน้า (base64) ก่อน แล้ววาง prompt เป็นข้อความตัวสุดท้าย ไม่มี system message = layout v3 ตาม single_pass.py::_ask จริง; temperature 0, max_tokens 8000

nodes.name: 04 VLM step 1 classify pages
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.4 - ยิง LiteLLM /v1/chat/completions รอบ classify - ตรงกับ single_pass.py::_ask + perception/litellm_client (model เดียวกันทุกขั้น = MODEL_VISION)

nodes.name: 05 Parse classify pick invoice pages
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.5 - หัวใจของงานที่ขอ: เลือกเฉพาะหน้าที่เป็น Invoice - port จาก single_pass.py::normalize_classify + select_invoice_pages + parse_marker (รองรับ 1/2 และ Page 1 of 2 / หน้า 2 จาก 2, ทิ้ง reprint ซ้ำเลข+marker, multi_invoice เมื่อเลขต่างกัน, pages_complete เมื่อ marker ไม่ครบ) - ไม่พบ invoice เลย = demo ใช้หน้า 1 + บันทึก fallback_used

nodes.name: 06 PDF to JPEG 150 DPI
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.1 - แตก PDF ซ้ำที่ 150 DPI เพื่อ OCR จริง (RENDER_DPI=150 ตาม .env) ตัวเลข/decimal ต้องคมกว่ารอบ classify

nodes.name: 07 Rotate invoice page upright
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.2 - เลือกเฉพาะหน้า Invoice ใบเดียว + หมุนให้ตั้งตามค่า r จากการ classify - ตรงกับ perception/coords.py::rotate_image_for_vlm (PIL rotate(-r, expand=True)) ทำให้ bbox อยู่บนเฟรมเดียวกับภาพที่ส่งให้โมเดล

nodes.name: 08 Build extract request
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.3 - ส่งภาพหน้า Invoice ใบเดียว + prompt extract (แทนที่ {page_no}) วางภาพก่อนข้อความ = layout v3 เดิม + วัดขนาดภาพจริงจาก header ของไฟล์ เพื่อใช้แปลง bbox 0..1000 -> พิกเซล

nodes.name: 09 VLM step 2 extract bbox
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.4 - OCR รอบที่ 2 ได้ fields + occurrences + line_items + regions + handwritten_refs ทุกค่ามี bbox_2d 0..1000 (coord_mode=norm1000 ตาม config/standards/v6.6) = single_pass.py::extract

nodes.name: 10 Bbox math pixels + sanitize
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.5 - bbox 0..1000 -> พิกเซลจริง แล้ว sanitize (สลับด้านที่กลับ, clip ขอบ, ทิ้งกล่องแบน) - mirror coords.py::xyxy_px + single_pass.py::validate_line_bbox (แถวต้องเป็นแถวนอน aspect>=1.5, กว้าง>=0.45W, สูง<=0.25H) + สร้าง ocr.elements[] แบบ domain/standard.py::extract_vlm + เตรียม overlay ตาม run_single_pass.py::overlay (ไม่วาด cell รายช่องให้รกภาพ แต่เก็บ bbox ไว้ใน JSON ครบ)

nodes.name: 12 Build final JSON + images
nodes.notes: ขั้น 3.2 - ประกอบ final JSON envelope เดียวกับ schemas/result-3.0.schema.json เติมเฉพาะส่วนที่ flow นี้ผลิตจริง; normalize/Oracle/matching/rules = {status:not_evaluated} ไว้ต่อยอดแบบ drop-in + ส่งรูป 2 ไฟล์เป็น base64 (original = หน้า Invoice ล้วน, annotated = +bbox)

nodes.name: 21 Validate (port)
nodes.notes: ห้ามแก้ไฟล์นี้ข้าม head: ต้อง rebuild ด้วย build_n8n_inline.mjs แล้วรัน harness/test_inline.mjs

nodes.name: 22 Verification report (9 rules)
nodes.notes: รวม 9 การ์ดเป็นตาราง + report_text และแนบ payload_sha256 ของ node 21 ไว้ยืนยันว่าเป็นผลชุดเดียวกับที่ถูก hash

nodes.name: 00 MANUAL TEST (doc_id=89)
nodes.notes: มีไว้เทสต์ blackbox เดี่ยว ๆ เท่านั้น (trigger แบบ Execute Workflow รัน manual ไม่ได้) - ไม่กระทบสายจริง

nodes.name: 05b Invoice pages found?
nodes.notes: true output = at least one invoice page was selected (normal path). false output = classify found no invoice page: the engine reads nothing at all, so this goes straight to node 21, which builds an extraction with zero reads (V-01 E01 -> REVIEW).

nodes.name: 06b Split selected pages
nodes.notes: One item per SELECTED invoice page, engine-unique binary names, orig frame kept under `pre` and node 07 writing the rotated frame to `page`. This is the node that closes the '.first() reads one page of a 2-page invoice' gap.

nodes.name: 05c1 Adjudicate allowed?
nodes.notes: Engine gate, both halves: the second look runs only when adjudication is enabled AND classify itself did not fail. Number comparisons only - the boolean operator fails strict typeValidation (exec 455).

nodes.name: 06r Render 150 DPI (adjudicate)
nodes.notes: single_pass._adjudicate: _render(page, adjudicate_dpi) then _data_url(img, quality=85). 85 and not 90 on purpose - the extract pass is q90, and the two are different requests.

nodes.name: 05c Adjudicate request
nodes.notes: One adjudicate request per page, 150 DPI unrotated JPEG q85, max_tokens 900.

nodes.name: 05d VLM step 1b adjudicate
nodes.notes: Same gateway and the same 600000 ms timeout as node 04 (engine perception client timeout is 600 s). An adjudicate wait must not live inside a Code node: the task runner kills a Code node at ~60 s (exec 456).

nodes.name: 05e Parse adjudicate + reselect
nodes.notes: quotes joined ' | ', invoice_wording, only non-invoice pages are reopened, then the SAME select_invoice_pages bytes node 05 runs. First failing page records page_errors.adjudicate and stops, like the engine's break.

nodes.name: 05f Invoice pages after adjudicate?
nodes.notes: true = the second look produced an invoice page, so read it. false = the document is refused with the adjudication log attached, never with a guessed page.

nodes.name: 09t Tax-id triage
nodes.notes: R6-13: one re-read per DOCUMENT (engine taxid_spent), fired on the first page in selection order whose answer fails the tax-id rule. An IF node cannot decide this — it evaluates per item and would re-read every failing page.

nodes.name: 09i Tax-id re-read needed?
nodes.notes: Number comparison only: the boolean operator fails strict typeValidation (exec 455). Exactly one item in the batch carries a page number.

nodes.name: 09r Render 300 DPI (tax-id)
nodes.notes: Engine single_pass.py:1053 re-renders the page at PERCEPTION_TAXID_RETRY_DPI (default 300). The pixels are the whole point of the retry: a bigger frame is the harder look.

nodes.name: 09o Prep re-read frame
nodes.notes: Picks the re-read page out of the 300 DPI render and puts page_no/rotate into json for node 09rot.

nodes.name: 09rot Rotate re-read upright
nodes.notes: _orient(hi_orig, p, rot['rotate_degrees']): the re-read keeps the page's orientation, so the answer's boxes mean the same thing as the first read's. Quality 90, like the extract pass.

nodes.name: 09b Build re-read request
nodes.notes: Same prompt, same max_tokens, same message order as a normal extract call — the engine calls _extract_one again, it does not invent a tax-id prompt.

nodes.name: 09c VLM step 3 tax-id re-read
nodes.notes: Same gateway, same 600000 ms timeout. onError=continueOnFail is the flow's version of the engine's try/except around the retry: if the harder look fails, the FIRST read stays in force and the run does not die (single_pass.py:1063-1065).

nodes.name: 09d Merge tax-id re-read
nodes.notes: Accept only when the whole high-resolution answer no longer breaks the rule; otherwise the first read stands. Logged either way into extra.taxid_retry (page/reason/dpi/accepted).

nodes.name: 09z Assemble extract reads
nodes.notes: Joins the branch back: one item per selected page with the answer AND the frame that answer came from. A re-read answer measured on 150 DPI pixels would scale boxes onto the wrong grid.

nodeGroups.name: Stage 1 - Paperless + แยกหน้า
nodeGroups.description: ดึงไฟล์จาก Paperless -> ย่อ 80 DPI -> ให้ VLM จำแนกหน้า -> คัดหน้า invoice

nodes.name: BB TRIGGER (doc_id from parent)
nodes.notes: parent ส่งมาแค่ { doc_id } - binary ขาเข้าข้าม workflow ไม่ได้ (exec 396)

assignments.name: prompt_classify
assignments.value:
<!-- prompt_id: single-pass-classify  version: 1.3.0 -->
You classify every page of ONE Thai/English accounting document set. Image 1 = page 1, Image 2 = page 2, ...

For each page answer:
- "p": page number (1-based, in image order)
- "t": "tax_invoice" | "invoice" | "delivery" | "po" | "other"
  - tax_invoice: the title has "ใบกำกับภาษี" / "TAX INVOICE" (also combined titles such as
    "ใบส่งของ/ใบกำกับภาษี", "ใบเสร็จรับเงิน/ใบกำกับภาษี", "ใบแจ้งหนี้/ใบกำกับภาษี")
  - invoice: "ใบแจ้งหนี้" / "INVOICE" without tax-invoice wording
  - delivery: "ใบส่งของ" / "ใบส่งสินค้า" / "DELIVERY ORDER" without tax-invoice wording
  - po: "ใบสั่งซื้อ" / "PURCHASE ORDER"
  - other: anything else (receipt, payment slip, packing list, photo, form)
- "c": "copy" ONLY when this page repeats the content of ANOTHER page of this set (same document number,
  same printed page position, same item rows, same totals). Otherwise "original".
  Words or stamps such as "สำเนา", "COPY", "คู่ฉบับ", "DUPLICATE", "ต้นฉบับ" are printed on originals too:
  they are NEVER enough on their own. A continuation sheet ("2/3") is never a copy of sheet "1/3".
- "n": the document number exactly as printed on this page, or null
- "m": the printed page position normalised to "a/b" ("หน้า 2/4" -> "2/4", "Page 1 of 3" -> "1/3"), or null
  when nothing is printed. Never invent it.
- "h": hand-written numbers of 6 or more digits on this page (e.g. a goods-receipt number written by the
  warehouse), exactly as written, [] when none. Never printed numbers.
- "r": rotation degrees needed to make this page upright: 0 | 90 | 180 | 270 (degrees clockwise to read upright, 0 if already upright)

Output ONLY JSON, no reasoning, no markdown:
{"pages":[{"p":1,"t":"tax_invoice","c":"original","n":"IV260904/003","m":"1/1","h":[],"r":0}]}

assignments.name: prompt_extract
assignments.value:
<!-- prompt_id: single-pass-extract  version: 1.7.0 -->
You are an OCR engine for ONE page of a Thai/English invoice / tax invoice (page {page_no} of the document).
Transcribe what is printed. Do not compute, correct, round, reformat or guess anything.

Every value is {"raw": "text exactly as printed", "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]} with coordinates in 0..1000
of THIS image. Keep commas, decimal points, slashes, hyphens, leading zeros, Thai digits and Thai words.
If a value is not printed on this page or cannot be read: {"raw": null, "bbox_2d": null}. Never guess a digit.

1. "fields" (header):
   invoice_num (เลขที่ใบกำกับ/ใบแจ้งหนี้), invoice_date, po_number (the CUSTOMER purchase order:
   "เลขที่ใบสั่งซื้อ / PO No. / ORDER NO"; NOT "สั่งซื้อภายใน"/internal order, NOT SO/DO numbers),
   supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, customer_name, customer_tax_id, customer_address,
   sub_total (before VAT), vat, grand_total, currency (only if printed, e.g. "THB", "บาท", "USD").
   Money: the value only, without the label. A total printed only in Thai words still counts.

   VALUE FIDELITY (this is where the model is weakest; measured on 49 invoices run twice):
   - Copy character by character, digit group by digit group. Never insert, drop, duplicate or reorder a digit.
     Printed 2610-00300 stays 2610-00300, never 2610-000300. If a digit is unreadable, return the field as null.
   - Stop at the end of the value; never append the adjacent date or a second reference:
     printed "42052615 / 2026-08-18" -> raw "42052615"; printed "40116654 / 00.00.0000" -> raw "40116654".
   - Never copy a label or prefix into raw: printed "PO 42052742" -> raw "42052742".
   - If one cell really prints several references, keep all of them exactly as printed, same order, same digits.

   LABEL BINDING - which block a number may come from. Measured on 223 invoices read twice: the biggest
   avoidable key-field error was not a mis-copied digit, it was the RIGHT number taken from the WRONG block.
   - The ISSUER is the company that issues and signs this document: the name at the top of the page with its
     logo, address and TEL lines (usually also the box "ต้นฉบับ / ORIGINAL"). Find the issuer first, then look
     for its tax id INSIDE that header block - it is often in small type on the "เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษีอากร"
     line directly under the address/TEL lines, or beside the logo, and it is often SMALLER than the
     customer's id. Never take supplier_tax_id from the buyer/customer block: "ผู้ซื้อ", "ลูกค้า",
     "ลูกค้า(CUSTOMER)", "Buyer", "Customer", "รหัสลูกค้า", "Bill To", "Ship To", or a "TAX ID:" printed
     beside the customer's name or code. Search that whole header block - including the small line under the
     logo - before returning null; null is for an id that is genuinely not printed for the issuer, never a
     reaction to having found the customer's. When the page prints only the customer's id, customer_tax_id
     carries it.
   - invoice_num is the number whose own label or heading names THIS document as an invoice/tax invoice.
     Choose in this order, and remember that **what a label means outranks where it is printed**:
     (a) any field labelled "เลขที่ใบกำกับภาษี", "ใบกำกับภาษีเลขที่", "TAX INVOICE NO.", "INVOICE NO.",
         "INV. NO." - take it even when it sits in the body of the page or in a shipment / charges block
         instead of the header;
     (b) only if nothing like (a) is printed: the "เลขที่ / No." in the header block under the document title.
     A generic label does NOT win while a label from (a) exists on the same page: "Doc No.", "Document No.",
     "เลขที่เอกสาร", "Ref", "Job No.", "HB/L NO.", "MB/L NO.", "AWB", "1st FLIGHT NO." - and "เล่มที่" is a
     VOLUME number, never a document number, even when it is printed above "เลขที่". On a page that prints only
     a "Doc No." and nothing from (a), that number is the document number and may be delivered.
     Never deliver as invoice_num: a delivery-note-only number ("ใบส่งของ",
     "ใบส่งสินค้า", "Delivery Order", "DO No."), a company/commercial registration number ("เลขทะเบียน
     บริษัท", "ทะเบียนพาณิชย์", "Company Registration"), a purchase order, a waybill / bill of lading, an
     internal order, or digits copied out of a tax id. When a page prints several such numbers, take the one
     whose label says ใบกำกับภาษี / TAX INVOICE - not the first number you see, and not the highest or lowest -
     and list every candidate in "occurrences" with the label you read next to it.

2. "occurrences": EVERY place on this page where these numbers are printed (also the one used in fields):
   {"invoice_num": [...], "po_number": [...], "supplier_tax_id": [...], "customer_tax_id": [...]}
   each item {"raw": "...", "label_text": "the printed label next to it, or empty", "bbox_2d": [...]}

3. "line_items": EVERY printed row of the item table, top to bottom, including continuation rows that only
   carry description text. Do not merge two rows that each print their own amount. Do not skip rows.
   {"line_no": 1, "item_code": {...}, "description": {...}, "qty": {...}, "uom": {...},
    "unit_price": {...}, "amount": {...}, "line_bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}
   - "line_bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2] MUST BE a horizontal rectangular bounding box encompassing the entire row from the leftmost column (item code / line no) to the rightmost column (amount), with width >> height (e.g. [45, 380, 950, 395]). NEVER return a vertical column slice as a line_bbox.
   If qty and unit are printed in one cell ("2 PCS"), put the whole text in qty and set uom raw null.
   Do not return the table header row or the sub-total / VAT / grand-total lines as rows.

   2D TABLE EXTRACTION RULES (VERTICAL COLUMNS & HORIZONTAL ROWS):
   a) Horizontal Row Gating (Multi-line Descriptions):
      - A valid "line_item" row MUST have a printed numeric "amount" (or "unit_price") on the right side of the table.
      - Text-only lines underneath an item (e.g., Coil No., Heat No., Lot No., PO reference, size specs, or remarks with empty qty/price/amount columns) are CONTINUATION lines. Append their text to the parent item's "description" — NEVER output them as separate line_items and NEVER assign a UOM or price to them.
   b) Vertical Header & Price-Unit Alignment (Dual Quantity Columns):
      - Inspect column headers vertically from top to bottom, including sub-headers under UNIT PRICE (e.g., "[B / KGS]", "THB/KG", "บาท/กก.").
      - When a row has numbers in multiple quantity/weight columns (e.g., QTY = 1 and KGS = 701), select the column whose header matches the unit in the UNIT PRICE header (KGS) AND satisfies the horizontal check: qty × unit_price ≈ amount (701 × 35.70 = 25,025.70).
      - The number assigned to qty must be physically printed in that row; never invent an unprinted number.
   c) Conditional UOM Inheritance (No Number, No Header UOM):
      - Priority 1: If a cell explicitly prints a unit next to the number (e.g., "1 SET", "2 PCS"), use that printed unit.
      - Priority 2: If a cell contains ONLY a number (e.g., "701" vertically aligned with KGS), inherit the UOM from that specific column's header (e.g., header "KGS" -> uom: "KG").
      - Priority 3: If the quantity/weight column is blank for that row (e.g., lump-sum service fee or discount line), set qty: null and uom: null — NEVER inherit the column header unit onto a row that has no number in that column.
   d) Negative Discount Parsing:
      - Rows with "ส่วนลด", "หัก", "Discount", "Less" must extract negative amounts.


4. "regions": [{"type": "table"|"stamp"|"signature"|"other", "label": "items_table" | "company_stamp" |
   "received_stamp" | "receiver_signature" | "deliverer_signature" | "authorized_signature" | ...,
   "present": "signed" | "empty", "bbox_2d": [...]}]
   "present" is required for signature and stamp boxes: "signed" when ANY hand-written mark or stamp ink is
   visible inside the box - even faint, partial or illegible; "empty" only when the box has no mark at all.
   ALWAYS return both signature boxes when the page prints them, even when they are empty:
   receiver_signature = the CUSTOMER's receiving box (ผู้รับสินค้า / ผู้รับของ / ลูกค้า / Customer / Received by);
   deliverer_signature = the SUPPLIER's box (ผู้ส่งสินค้า / ผู้ส่งของ / ผู้มีอำนาจลงนาม / Sender / Authorized).
   Stamps are separate regions: label "received_stamp" for a warehouse receiving stamp (RECEIVED / ได้รับสินค้า),
   "company_stamp" for the supplier's company stamp.

5. "handwritten_refs": hand-written numbers anywhere on the page (e.g. a goods-receipt number written by
   the warehouse): [{"raw": "...", "bbox_2d": [...]}]

Output ONLY JSON starting with { and ending with }, no reasoning, no markdown:
{"fields": {"invoice_num": {"raw": "26/2691", "bbox_2d": [722, 138, 852, 152]}, "po_number": {"raw": null, "bbox_2d": null}},
 "occurrences": {"invoice_num": [{"raw": "26/2691", "label_text": "เลขที่ / No.", "bbox_2d": [722, 138, 852, 152]}]},
 "line_items": [{"line_no": 1, "item_code": {"raw": "509-1200-150", "bbox_2d": [48, 380, 200, 395]},
   "description": {"raw": "SOLID CARBIDE ENDMILL", "bbox_2d": [205, 380, 600, 395]},
   "qty": {"raw": "3", "bbox_2d": [610, 380, 650, 395]}, "uom": {"raw": "PCS", "bbox_2d": [655, 380, 700, 395]},
   "unit_price": {"raw": "3,794.00", "bbox_2d": [710, 380, 800, 395]},
   "amount": {"raw": "11,382.00", "bbox_2d": [810, 380, 990, 395]}, "line_bbox": [20, 375, 995, 400]}],
 "regions": [{"type": "signature", "label": "receiver_signature", "present": "signed", "bbox_2d": [100, 850, 300, 920]}],
 "handwritten_refs": []}

nodes.name: 00 CONFIG (single point)
nodes.notes: CONFIG จุดเดียวของ flow - mirror container.py::Settings (PAPERLESS_BASE_URL, LITELLM_URL, MODEL_VISION, RENDER_DPI=150, CLASSIFY_RENDER_DPI=80, VLM_MAX_TOKENS=8000) + prompt จาก config/prompts/single_pass_classify.md (1.3.0), single_pass_extract.md (1.6.0) + สีจาก run_single_pass.py::COLORS - ทุก node อ้างกลับมาที่นี่ที่เดียว

nodes.name: 02 PDF to JPEG 80 DPI (classify)
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.2 - แตก PDF เป็นภาพทุกหน้าที่ 80 DPI เพื่อใช้จำแนกหน้าเท่านั้น - เดียวกับ perception/single_pass.py::_render(page, classify_dpi=80)

nodes.name: 03 Build classify request
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.3 - ยัดภาพทุกหน้า (base64) ก่อน แล้ววาง prompt เป็นข้อความตัวสุดท้าย ไม่มี system message = layout v3 ตาม single_pass.py::_ask จริง; temperature 0, max_tokens 8000

nodes.name: 04 VLM step 1 classify pages
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.4 - ยิง LiteLLM /v1/chat/completions รอบ classify - ตรงกับ single_pass.py::_ask + perception/litellm_client (model เดียวกันทุกขั้น = MODEL_VISION)

nodes.name: 05 Parse classify pick invoice pages
nodes.notes: ขั้น 1.5 - หัวใจของงานที่ขอ: เลือกเฉพาะหน้าที่เป็น Invoice - port จาก single_pass.py::normalize_classify + select_invoice_pages + parse_marker (รองรับ 1/2 และ Page 1 of 2 / หน้า 2 จาก 2, ทิ้ง reprint ซ้ำเลข+marker, multi_invoice เมื่อเลขต่างกัน, pages_complete เมื่อ marker ไม่ครบ) - ไม่พบ invoice เลย = demo ใช้หน้า 1 + บันทึก fallback_used

nodes.name: 06 PDF to JPEG 150 DPI
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.1 - แตก PDF ซ้ำที่ 150 DPI เพื่อ OCR จริง (RENDER_DPI=150 ตาม .env) ตัวเลข/decimal ต้องคมกว่ารอบ classify

nodes.name: 07 Rotate invoice page upright
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.2 - เลือกเฉพาะหน้า Invoice ใบเดียว + หมุนให้ตั้งตามค่า r จากการ classify - ตรงกับ perception/coords.py::rotate_image_for_vlm (PIL rotate(-r, expand=True)) ทำให้ bbox อยู่บนเฟรมเดียวกับภาพที่ส่งให้โมเดล

nodes.name: 08 Build extract request
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.3 - ส่งภาพหน้า Invoice ใบเดียว + prompt extract (แทนที่ {page_no}) วางภาพก่อนข้อความ = layout v3 เดิม + วัดขนาดภาพจริงจาก header ของไฟล์ เพื่อใช้แปลง bbox 0..1000 -> พิกเซล

nodes.name: 09 VLM step 2 extract bbox
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.4 - OCR รอบที่ 2 ได้ fields + occurrences + line_items + regions + handwritten_refs ทุกค่ามี bbox_2d 0..1000 (coord_mode=norm1000 ตาม config/standards/v6.6) = single_pass.py::extract

nodes.name: 10 Bbox math pixels + sanitize
nodes.notes: ขั้น 2.5 - bbox 0..1000 -> พิกเซลจริง แล้ว sanitize (สลับด้านที่กลับ, clip ขอบ, ทิ้งกล่องแบน) - mirror coords.py::xyxy_px + single_pass.py::validate_line_bbox (แถวต้องเป็นแถวนอน aspect>=1.5, กว้าง>=0.45W, สูง<=0.25H) + สร้าง ocr.elements[] แบบ domain/standard.py::extract_vlm + เตรียม overlay ตาม run_single_pass.py::overlay (ไม่วาด cell รายช่องให้รกภาพ แต่เก็บ bbox ไว้ใน JSON ครบ)

nodes.name: 12 Build final JSON + images
nodes.notes: ขั้น 3.2 - ประกอบ final JSON envelope เดียวกับ schemas/result-3.0.schema.json เติมเฉพาะส่วนที่ flow นี้ผลิตจริง; normalize/Oracle/matching/rules = {status:not_evaluated} ไว้ต่อยอดแบบ drop-in + ส่งรูป 2 ไฟล์เป็น base64 (original = หน้า Invoice ล้วน, annotated = +bbox)

nodes.name: 21 Validate (port)
nodes.notes: ห้ามแก้ไฟล์นี้ข้าม head: ต้อง rebuild ด้วย build_n8n_inline.mjs แล้วรัน harness/test_inline.mjs

nodes.name: 22 Verification report (9 rules)
nodes.notes: รวม 9 การ์ดเป็นตาราง + report_text และแนบ payload_sha256 ของ node 21 ไว้ยืนยันว่าเป็นผลชุดเดียวกับที่ถูก hash

nodes.name: 00 MANUAL TEST (doc_id=89)
nodes.notes: มีไว้เทสต์ blackbox เดี่ยว ๆ เท่านั้น (trigger แบบ Execute Workflow รัน manual ไม่ได้) - ไม่กระทบสายจริง

nodeGroups.name: Stage 1 - Paperless + แยกหน้า
nodeGroups.description: ดึงไฟล์จาก Paperless -> ย่อ 80 DPI -> ให้ VLM จำแนกหน้า -> คัดหน้า invoice

nodeGroups.name: Stage 2 - OCR หน้า Invoice
nodeGroups.description: Render 150 DPI -> หมุนหน้าตรง -> VLM สกัด field + bbox -> คํานวณ pixel

nodeGroups.name: Stage 3 - ประกอบ payload + validate
nodeGroups.description: ประกอบ result/3.0 + รัน rules V-01..V-09 + ตาราง 9 ใบ (logic ทั้งหมดอยู่ใน node 21)
